prompt:
Create TEST 2: a NEW standalone fantasy game splash-art BACKGROUND ONLY, concept "a tree with fluttering WHITE CHERRY BLOSSOMS, with swirling WIND at GROUND LEVEL". Use the attached image exclusively as a reference for clean anime rendering, layered dimensional wind, cool palette and isolated transparent vignette presentation. Do not carry over its arrow, stone ruins, arches, bridge or other scene objects. This is a separate nature-themed composition.

MAIN SCENE:
One elegant mature WHITE flowering cherry tree rises from a small exposed irregular patch of ground. A sculptural cool gray-brown trunk grows slightly off center, roots visibly grip the ground, graceful branching sweeps outward and upward into airy asymmetric clusters of white blossoms. Recognizable five-petaled cherry flowers and slender twigs; WHITE petals with delicate pearl-gray shading and tiny restrained warm centers, no pink blossom canopy. Some small fresh pale-green leaves, but flowers dominate. Separate large flower clusters with open gaps, don't render them as shapeless cotton or snow. The trunk has stylized broad bark planes, not photoreal microtexture.

GROUND VORTEX MUST BE CLEAR:
At the tree's base, a strong low, horizontal swirling wind circles the exposed roots. Show two or three flowing semi-transparent white and very pale teal pressure bands as flattened perspective ellipses hugging the ground, with near arcs wider and farther arcs narrower. The far half goes BEHIND the trunk, the near half passes IN FRONT of the roots and foreground ground edge: unmistakable three-dimensional overlap. Make one main readable vortex, not a stack of flat decorative rings. Sweep scattered fallen white petals along this circular path.
A thinner ascending spiral lifts petals from this basal vortex past the trunk and into the open air beside the canopy. Petals follow consistent curved trajectories, not uniformly scattered confetti. A few larger near petals and many smaller distant ones give depth. Wind has airy tapering edges and fine speed streaks, no water, foam, liquid splashes, waves, ice, opaque fabric ribbons or solid glowing tubes.

COMPOSITION AND STYLE:
One complete isolated environmental splash vignette, no character, person, humanoid, animal, bow, arrow or weapon. Main visual hierarchy: white cherry tree, ground-level vortex, lifted petals. Near-square canvas. Slightly elevated three-quarter camera sufficient to see the rotating wind on the ground. Clear foreground roots/petals, middle trunk, rear branches and flowering canopy. The vortex is low around the feet of the tree, not an enormous tornado covering the trunk or canopy. Open asymmetrical silhouette and deliberate quiet gaps so a character could later be composited; no humanoid blank cutout.
Use the same established polished 2D anime dimensional-space style as the supplied reference: clean fine contours, broad controlled cel-shaded forms, selective gradients and translucency, crisp important shapes with softer distant areas. White/pearl-gray/pale lime/teal dominate; muted cool gray-brown wood for readable trunk. Natural light from upper left and restrained teal reflected light near roots. Do not turn it into flat logo/pattern art, rough oil painting, photorealism or a 3D render.
Ground is only a modest irregular gray-earth and moss patch held by the roots, not a big circular stone pedestal or floating architectural platform. Keep the whole tree crown, all major branches, root base, wind and petals safely within the canvas with clear transparent breathing room on all sides. Outside this composed vignette is genuine TRANSPARENT alpha; no rectangular sky/landscape, white rectangle, black background or painted checkerboard. No labels, title, watermark, logo, UI or frame. Deliver ONE finished background splash.
framingEdit: Edit ONLY the framing of this exact white cherry blossom tree and ground wind splash. Zoom the complete artwork out about 18 percent within the same square transparent canvas. Fully reveal and finish the uppermost branch, leaves and white blossom clusters, all left/right branches, ground patch and foreground swirling wind: the current upper crown is clipped. Naturally complete that crown without changing the tree's silhouette design. Leave a clear transparent margin of 6–8 percent on all four sides around every major branch, blossom, root and wind extremity. Keep the same tree, gray-brown sculptural trunk, white five-petal blossoms, pale green leaves, scattered airborne petals, ground-level white/teal vortex, fine clean anime drawing and restrained soft cel shading, colors, lighting and perspective. Preserve true alpha transparency and translucency. No new objects, no character, arrow, bow, text, labels or border. One full uncut background illustration.
